show.description: Bloodline Betrayal is a suspenseful romantic drama about love, trust, and shocking secrets. Rhea, who wakes up from a two-year coma, finds her world shattered—her husband married to her best friend and her identity almost erased. As she pieces her life back together, betrayal turns into vengeance, and love into a dangerous game where nothing is as it seems.
